name: Igusa Yasunari
source:
Usually looking rough and nonchalant, Yasunari is not that difficult to deal with in reality. While he is responsible enough to do whatever is expected of him, he overlooks details so often that many consider him careless.

When he is with Ayana, his childhood friend, they talk like a long-married couple. Ever since he encountered Rio in school on the even of the Miniature Festival, he has not been able to take her off of his mind.

[Edited from [url=http://fruitbatfactory.com/miniature/]Fruitbat Factory[/url]]
